news.title: ‘Unimaginable loss’: 2 boys die, 2 women hurt in shooting
news.summary: DeKalb County PD confirmed Sunday night that two boys died and two women were wounded in a shooting.

news.title: 2 children killed, 2 women injured in DeKalb County shooting
news.summary: An 11-year-old boy and a 12-year-old boy died after a shooting on North Hairston Road that DeKalb County investigators suspect stemmed from an earlier argument.

news.title: Dead birds, baby goats found along metro Atlanta walking trail
news.summary: Neighbors are raising concerns after several dead animals, including baby goats with their legs bound, were found along a popular DeKalb County walking trail.

news.title: 2 boys killed, 2 women injured in deadly shooting at Stone Mountain home, police say
news.summary: Police said that 11-year-old and 12-year-old boys were tragically killed in the shooting that stemmed from a disagreement earlier in the day.

news.title: 14-time felon sentenced for possessing stolen gun
news.summary: A 43-year-old Atlanta man was sentenced to nearly nine years in prison for illegally possessing a stolen firearm.

news.title: Falcons quarterback struggles continue in 34-3 loss to Panthers
news.summary: Atlanta fans wanted a change at quarterback on Sunday, but the entrance of undrafted rookie Jack Strand ended in a quick pick-6 during a 34-3 loss to Carolina.

news.title: Three arrested in $65K East Point apartment rent fraud scheme
news.summary: Three women face multiple charges after allegedly stealing around $65,000 in rent payments from residents at the Fulton Pointe Apartments in East Point.

news.title: Stabbing near Fulton County Medical Examiner's Office deemed self-inflicted: APD
news.summary: A person was taken to the hospital with a self-inflicted stab wound near the Fulton County Medical Examiner's Office, Atlanta Police report.

news.title: DeKalb Police seize 735 pounds of marijuana, 9 guns in drug bust
news.summary: DeKalb County Police announced on Friday that its officers intercepted a massive out-of-state drug delivery leading to the seizure of more than 700 pounds of marijuana and nearly a dozen firearms.
